largeMonthlyMoveReview.finding: Same75-share basket quantity and gradual daily falls; no split evidence found in inspected September/October disclosures or daily path. Retained as an unadjusted price-return outlier.

methodology.daily: 100 * (selected date unadjusted KRX close / preceding trading-date unadjusted KRX close - 1)
methodology.monthly: 100 * (2026-10-16 close / 2026-09-16 close - 1); one calendar month. No daily-percent summing.
methodology.membership: Current end-date index constituent universe, corroborated through all collected daily issuer baskets. Not market-cap top200/150.
methodology.valuationDate: Each PDF effective date contains prior completed session valuation. The 2026-10-19 effective basket was published on/before collection2026-10-17 and values2026-10-16 closes, not future prices.
methodology.adjustments: Unadjusted price return; cash dividends are excluded and no total-return claim is made. Corporate-action price/quantity jumps are screened; absence of flags is not a guarantee of complete corporate-action coverage.
methodology.discardedSource: Naver current/daily price endpoints can include after-hours close and quote percent against a different base. Those price rows were not used for final returns.
